topology.value: dual-channel double-sided long-primary LIM; four same-station stator faces series-connected to one three-phase converter

segments_main_active.note: Normal operation cycles between two and three adjacent 3 m longitudinal segments according to the 4.5 m secondary overlap position. Three full-current segments are a recurring normal operating state, not only a brief handover envelope.

main_energized_length_m.note: Geometric energized stator length is 6 m in the two-segment state and 9 m in the three-segment state. This does not imply that all energized stator length has equal electromagnetic overlap with the 4.5 m secondary.

secondary_al_thickness_mm.note: Thickness baseline accepted 2026-09-22. Current V2 uses a 4.5 m continuous secondary for electromagnetic analysis; split/joint construction is not part of the V2 baseline.

secondary_effective_width_mm.note: 1.2 m selected to reduce transverse current-closure penalty with an 800 mm primary.

normal_main_active_segments.note: Two- and three-segment states recur during normal travel as the 4.5 m secondary moves across 3 m stator segmentation.

max_simultaneous_energized_segments_hand.note: Legacy field name retained for compatibility. Three simultaneously energized segments are not handover-only; they are a recurring normal overlap state.

electrical_connection_note.value: Four same-station faces are series-connected within each longitudinal 3 m segment. Adjacent longitudinal segments are separate converter branches; their resistances are not series-added at a converter terminal.

two_segment_active_hbridge_sources.basis: 2 longitudinal converter groups x 12 H-bridge cells/group

three_segment_active_hbridge_sources.basis: 3 longitudinal converter groups x 12 H-bridge cells/group

storage_power_sizing_principle.value: Use the two-segment simultaneous-operation state as the governing per-H-bridge / per-supercapacitor maximum-power sizing case. The recurring three-segment state distributes the same system propulsion demand across three converter groups and therefore does not supersede the two-segment case for maximum per-source power sizing.

max_simultaneous_energized_segments.note: Three adjacent 3 m longitudinal segments can be simultaneously energized as a recurring normal operating state. They are supplied by independent A/B/C converter branches and are not electrically series-connected.

max_simultaneous_energized_length_m.note: Geometric sum of three simultaneously energized 3 m segments during the recurring three-segment normal state.

active_slot_pack_envelope_mm.note: Homogenized 3-turn pack envelope; not solid copper.

routing_rule.value: A/C/B phase-separated side corridors; top and bottom stators use opposite +/-Y routing sides; rounded end transitions; no phase/core/secondary solid overlap

conductor_copper_area_per_turn_mm2.note: Current copper-loss reference. Final rectangular conductor dimensions and insulation build remain open.

three_phase_copper_loss_equivalent_resis.note: Sum of A/B/C phase resistances after four same-station stator faces are series-connected. Use only in Pcu = I^2 * Rsum for one energized longitudinal segment.

copper_loss_equivalent_resistance_mOhm.note: Loss-equivalent sums across independent longitudinal converter branches. These are not electrical series resistances seen by any one converter.

ac_resistance_multiplier_screening.note: Initial 43-44 Hz skin/proximity allowance pending detailed stranded/rectangular-conductor AC loss FEA.

copper_loss_reference_kW_3500A_design_en.note: Short-pulse envelope only; not a continuous thermal operating point.

end_leakage_inductance_mH_per_phase_per_.note: V4.2 values are extracted from the current 3D winding path. Preferred value includes top/bottom double-sided stator mutual coupling. Conservative value neglects face-to-face mutual coupling. The old 0.385 mH V4 geometry-scaled value is superseded for current design work.

end_leakage_extraction_method.value: actual V4.2 end paths; active-slot conductors excluded; analytic regularized self term + 8-point Gauss-Legendre mutual integration; balanced positive-sequence energy extraction; free-space result calibrated to the historical V4 0.4461 mH reference; high-mu image multiplier 1.1465/0.4461 = 2.5701

current_3d_model.scope: one complete physical double-sided DSLIM channel with two adjacent 3 m stator segments, explicit V4.2 top/bottom winding geometry, and centered 4.5 m x 1.2 m x 16 mm aluminium secondary
current_3d_model.replication_rule: Two physical DSLIM channels are required for the four-face system. Inter-channel mechanical pitch is not frozen, so the model defines one complete channel and a duplication rule rather than inventing channel spacing.
current_3d_model.collision_audit: PASS: A/B/C phase-to-phase, winding-to-core, and winding-to-secondary intersection volumes are zero in the validated representative geometry.

slip_frequency.note: Direct nonlinear 16 mm 2D moving-conductor FEM on the accepted V2 geometry. Operating band remains conditional pending self-consistent finite-width 3D closure.

main_converter_voltage_class_kV.note: 40 m/s V2 converter output class remains 4.5 kV. The former 4.01-4.15 kV motor terminal-voltage screening used the superseded 0.385 mH V4 end-leakage estimate and must be recomputed with the current V4.2 0.273 mH preferred / 0.323 mH conservative leakage values.

insulation_interface_margin_kV.note: Retained pending final PWM insulation coordination and physical winding closure.

main_converter_pulse_current_class_kA_rm.note: Pulse/current design envelope. Current 500 kN finite-width screening reference is about 2.35 kA RMS.

topology.value: three-phase cascaded H-bridge, 4 H-bridge cells per phase

devices_per_switch_position.note: No semiconductor paralleling in the accepted baseline.

reference_device.value: Infineon FZ3600R17HP4_B2 or verified equivalent 1700 V / 3600 A class single-switch IGBT module

cell_dc_bus_operating_window_kV.note: Accepted normal operating window for the 4-cell-per-phase 1700 V IGBT CHB baseline.

switching_frequency_Hz_per_device.note: 300 Hz is the accepted initial design point. Final value may move within the screening range after detailed loss, acoustic/EMI and double-pulse validation without reopening the topology.

modulation.value: phase-shifted-carrier PWM across four H-bridge cells per phase

equivalent_resistance_mOhm_target_max.note: Target required to retain approximately 1.0 kV minimum local DC-link voltage at the 3.5 kA RMS design-envelope screening case.

equivalent_resistance_mOhm_normal_operat.note: Acceptable for the approximately 2.35 kA RMS / 500 kN normal screening point; not sufficient to guarantee the full 3.5 kA envelope.

commutation_loop.note: Separate from the microhenry-scale storage feed inductance. Final clamp level and loop inductance require double-pulse/hardware validation.

validation_summary.model_grade: converter screening-grade; final double-pulse, parasitic extraction and hardware thermal validation remain required

stator_face_airgap_pressure_screening_kN.note: Stator-face structural magnetic-pressure screening load; not a force acting on the aluminium secondary.

electromagnetic_restoring_stiffness_tota.note: Cross-check from the older direct JxB stiffness scaling and air-gap spatial-decay model; not freeze-grade.

mechanical_guide_stiffness_target_kN_per.basis: 12.5 t upper moving mass, 50 deg launch angle, about 0.3 mm displacement objective and about 25 Hz lateral rigid-body target.

secondary_split_16mm.configuration: two 2.9 m plates per channel, 16 mm Al, 2-3 mm center gap, common mechanical carrier, electrically unbridged
secondary_split_16mm.status: V2 baseline uses a 4.5 m continuous 16 mm secondary for electromagnetic design. The older 2 x 2.9 m split/joint concept remains historical analysis only.

system_40mps_nominal_requirement.basis: 12,000 kg nominal moving mass, 50 deg incline, 3g net acceleration
system_40mps_nominal_requirement.note: 2D current is from direct 16 mm FEM. The 3.6 Hz transverse-corrected reference uses the 1.2 m secondary current-closure screening and is not freeze-grade.

motor_40mps_design_capability.note: Direct 16 mm nonlinear 2D FEM plus local finite-width/end-leakage screening. Current and voltage remain conditional pending a self-consistent full 3D H(curl) moving-conductor closure.

historical_40mps_3Hz_reference.note: The 2.74 kV / PF 0.87 / efficiency / B values are retained only for traceability from the earlier 3 Hz engineering reference. They must not be combined with the 2.44 Hz maximum-thrust point or treated as the frozen operating point. This reference also uses the former 12 mm secondary.

baseline_change_20260922_secondary_16mm.evidence: 20260921_secondary_split_16mm_validation.md showed viable 16 mm electromagnetic performance; split/joint construction is not frozen by this decision
downstream_actions: recheck normal force and structural load
recheck transverse edge effect for the current candidate geometry
update sled active aluminium mass when secondary planform is frozen

historical_normal_force_12mm.note: 2D longitudinal result; restoring sign must not be credited as a safety feature until 3D/transient validation.

historical_12mm_v1.summary: 2 m segments, 5.8 m secondary, 600 mm primary width, 12 mm aluminium, 42x60 mm slots, 80 mm yoke, 8 turns; retained only for traceability.

baseline_change_20260922_motor_v2.accepted_architecture: four same-station stator faces series-fed by one three-phase converter; three modulo-3 longitudinal converter groups
baseline_change_20260922_motor_v2.downstream_impact: V1 electrical points and topology are superseded; converter envelope moves to 4.5 kV / 3.5 kA conditional; mechanical guide and stator support screening updated.

technology.note: Technology is frozen; vendor, cell/module type, capacitance, ESR and series/parallel realization remain open.

chb_dc_source_interface.value: each CHB H-bridge cell requires an electrically isolated/floating DC source
chb_dc_source_interface.note: Direct-coupled supercapacitor versus an isolated bidirectional DC/DC implementation remains OPEN.

cell_dc_bus_operating_window_kV.note: Updated to match the accepted 1.7 kV IGBT, 4-cell-per-phase CHB baseline.

cell_dc_bus_derated_min_kV.note: 1.0 kV is the accepted normal lower DC-link operating point for the converter baseline.

system_usable_energy_MJ_min.note: First-round 40 m/s launch requirement including nominal mission energy plus motor, converter and storage-loss/design margin. Final value requires full launch-profile loss integration.

system_peak_discharge_power_MW_min.note: Screening requirement based on 500 kN design thrust at 40 m/s (20 MW mechanical) plus motor/converter losses and engineering margin.

full_power_pulse_duration_s_min.note: Covers the approximately 1.36 s 0-to-40 m/s constant-3g launch time with margin.

recharge_time_h_max.note: Must support the system launch interval requirement of at least 2 h.

average_discharge_power_MW.note: Approximately 0.96 MW per H-bridge at the 500 kN / 40 m/s reference point.

regenerative_operation.note: The storage system must accept regenerative energy during electromagnetic braking. Final regenerative power and energy rating remain OPEN pending the braking profile closure.

local_dc_link_ripple_policy.value: each H-bridge uses a local 40-60 mF low-ESL film DC-link bank; nominal design point 50 mF
local_dc_link_ripple_policy.note: Supercapacitor source carries average power and most low-frequency 2f power. Local film bank carries PWM/commutation ripple. Nominal rating >=1.25 kV, >=2.0 kA RMS ripple (2.5 kA preferred), >=5 kA pulse.

insulation_interface.value: floating storage source per H-bridge; insulation coordination compatible with the converter 5 kV interface margin
insulation_interface.note: Exact withstand levels, creepage/clearance and grounding scheme remain OPEN until the physical CHB cabinet and PWM insulation design are closed.

open_selection_items: direct coupling versus isolated bidirectional DC/DC
final local DC-link film capacitance and 2f ripple-power sharing

baseline_change_20260922_energy_storage_.old_value: technology only; no electrical interface or pulse-performance requirements
baseline_change_20260922_energy_storage_.reason: Provide a stable storage-to-converter interface before detailed CHB design without freezing a specific supercapacitor product.

500 kN design thrust gives 20 MW mechanical power at 40 m/s
current V2 converter envelope is 4.5 kV class / 3.5 kA conditional
2-cell-per-phase CHB screening supports a 2.0-2.5 kV cell DC operating window
downstream_impact: converter cell voltage and modulation design
local DC-link ripple-buffer sizing

regenerative braking energy path

baseline_change_20260923_converter_1p7kV.parameter: converter architecture and storage-to-converter electrical interface
baseline_change_20260923_converter_1p7kV.old_value: CONDITIONAL 2-cell/phase CHB using 4.5 kV-class semiconductors and 2.0-2.5 kV/cell DC bus
baseline_change_20260923_converter_1p7kV.new_value: ACCEPTED 4-cell/phase CHB using 1.7 kV / 3.6 kA-class single IGBT modules and 1.0-1.1 kV/cell DC bus
baseline_change_20260923_converter_1p7kV.reason: Targeted PWM, semiconductor-current, 1.5 s transient-thermal and DC-link RLC screening showed adequate voltage synthesis, single-device current margin and controllable local DC-link ripple with lower-voltage high-current IGBTs.
evidence: At 1.0 kV/cell the present ~4.066 kV motor reference requires modulation index about 0.83; the 4.5 kV converter class requires about 0.919.
At the 2.345 kA RMS normal point, worst single IGBT RMS/peak current is about 1.46/3.32 kA.
At the 3.5 kA RMS design envelope, worst single IGBT RMS/peak current is about 2.18/4.95 kA; 1.5 s screening delta-Tj-c is about 29 K.
With 50 mF local DC link, 10 mOhm source resistance and 3 uH feed inductance, 3.5 kA screening gives about 999 V minimum DC link and 67.9 Vpp ripple.
Increasing film capacitance cannot compensate excessive source ESR; source equivalent resistance therefore becomes a hard storage-interface requirement.
downstream_impact: supercapacitor branch voltage changes from 2.0-2.5 kV to 1.0-1.1 kV per H-bridge
H-bridge count changes from 6 to 12 per three-phase converter
IGBT module count becomes 48 per three-phase converter / 144 across three longitudinal converter groups
per-cell average power halves to approximately 1 MW while each cell still carries full phase current
DC-link film capacitor bank, storage branch ESR/ESL, precharge, protection and cabinet count must be redesigned for 36 floating H-bridge cells
insulation/common-mode behavior changes because the number of cascaded cells doubles and per-cell dv/dt voltage step decreases
baseline_change_20260923_converter_1p7kV.recommendation: FROZEN architecture; detailed hardware parameters remain conditional where explicitly marked

baseline_change_20260923_winding_model.parameter: motor segmentation active-state definition, V4.2 winding parameters and current 3D motor model
baseline_change_20260923_winding_model.old_value: normal two active segments only; winding resistance based on simplified scaling; 3D V4.2 model not versioned in main baseline
baseline_change_20260923_winding_model.new_value: normal two segments plus maximum three simultaneously energized during handover; V4.2 CAD-derived phase lengths/resistances; canonical parametric 3D model versioned
baseline_change_20260923_winding_model.reason: 4.5 m secondary can span the transition between 3 m modules and handover can require three adjacent energized segments; copper loss must use actual V4.2 3D winding path rather than length/turn scaling.
evidence: V4.2 CAD phase copper lengths per 3 m face: A 57.641 m, B 61.943 m, C 62.951 m.
At 80 C and 300 mm2/turn: per-face phase resistances A/B/C = 4.094/4.399/4.471 mOhm.
Four-face series per 3 m longitudinal segment gives A/B/C = 16.374/17.596/17.882 mOhm per converter phase.
500 kN / 3.6 Hz / 2.345 kA screening copper loss = 0.599 MW for two full-current segments and 0.898 MW for three full-current segments.
downstream_impact: motor thermal design and launch energy integration
three-group CHB instantaneous power during handover
supercapacitor peak-power margin
segment-handover control current ramps
final copper conductor and cooling design

baseline_change_20260923_segmentation_op.parameter: motor longitudinal segmentation operating-state definition and storage maximum-power sizing interpretation
baseline_change_20260923_segmentation_op.old_value: two active segments treated as normal; three active segments treated mainly as a handover maximum
baseline_change_20260923_segmentation_op.new_value: normal travel repeatedly alternates between two and three simultaneously energized 3 m segments; three full-current segments are a recurring normal state
baseline_change_20260923_segmentation_op.reason: A 4.5 m secondary moving across 3 m stator segmentation geometrically overlaps three adjacent segments for a substantial portion of each segment pitch, including when the secondary is centered over a 3 m segment.
evidence: With a 4.5 m secondary centered on a 3 m stator segment, overlap is approximately 0.75 m + 3.0 m + 0.75 m across three adjacent segments.
Over one 3 m segmentation pitch, the geometric three-segment overlap interval is approximately 1.5 m, i.e. about 50% of travel before control ramp extensions.
downstream_impact: motor copper-loss and thermal duty-cycle accounting must include recurring three-segment operation
three converter groups and 36 H-bridge sources can be simultaneously active in normal operation
segment-transition control and thrust-continuity validation must model recurring two/three-segment states
per-source storage maximum-power sizing remains governed by the two-segment state because the same propulsion demand is concentrated into 24 rather than 36 H-bridge sources
baseline_change_20260923_segmentation_op.recommendation: FROZEN operational interpretation; transient current sharing remains to be validated

baseline_change_20260923_v42_end_leakage.old_value: 0.385 mH/phase high-mu screening value from V4 geometry scaling
baseline_change_20260923_v42_end_leakage.reason: Current V4.2 CAD explicitly defines six end-turn layers, phase-separated routing corridors, series links and terminal leads; leakage should be extracted from the actual current geometry rather than the older V4 scaling.
evidence: Analytic regularized self terms plus 8-point Gauss-Legendre mutual integration on the current V4.2 path.
Calibration against the historical V4 free-space reference 0.4461 mH/phase.
Preferred result includes double-sided top/bottom stator mutual coupling; conservative result neglects face-to-face mutual coupling.
downstream_impact: motor terminal-voltage and power-factor recalculation
4.5 kV CHB modulation margin
5 kV insulation/interface margin review
phase-impedance and protection settings
baseline_change_20260923_v42_end_leakage.recommendation: Use 0.273 mH/phase as the current engineering value and 0.323 mH/phase as the conservative voltage-design upper screening value; keep full 3D H(curl) closure open.
